data.one_liner: A zero-dependency charting library with 27 chart types and built-in interactivity.
data.what_it_does: Drafter provides 27 different chart types built purely in Flutter using CustomPaint and Canvas. It features smooth Catmull-Rom curves, soft gradient fills, a left-to-right reveal animation, built-in semantics, and an optional interactive layer for tooltips, selection, and ranges.
use_when: You need a wide variety of charts ranging from standard bar and line charts to heatmaps, treemaps, and gantt charts.
You want zero external dependencies beyond the Flutter SDK.
You need built-in interactivity like touch/mouse tooltips, selection, and range dragging without setting up complex event listeners.
avoid_when: You need highly complex enterprise mapping or domain-specific charting features not covered by the 27 included types.
You prefer a non-Flutter native rendering engine for performance reasons on extremely large data sets.
strengths: Zero dependencies beyond the Flutter SDK.
Supports 27 distinct chart types out of the box.
Opt-in interactive tracking, tooltips, and range selection painted efficiently on a canvas overlay.
weaknesses: Relatively new package which may lack long-term ecosystem maturity compared to older giants like fl_chart or syncfusion_flutter_charts.
Custom canvas rendering might require extra work if you need deeply customized non-standard UI elements outside the built-in properties.
data.setup_notes: None. Pure Dart package with zero external dependencies.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you want a battle-tested, highly popular community standard for Flutter charts.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you require an enterprise-grade chart library with extensive documentation and complex financial or technical indicators.
